requiredFindings.does: vault.upgradeToAndCall(VaultV2, reinitializeV2(wallet 14)) reassigns Vault owner from Timelock to wallet index 14
treasury.approve(USDC, wallet 14, max) grants unlimited USDC allowance to wallet index 14
VaultV2 implementation introduces new backdoor selectors including migrateReserves and reinitializeV2

contradictions.a: no change to ownership, roles or reserves
The Timelock remains the sole owner of the Vault.
contradictions.b: OwnershipTransferred event sets new owner to wallet index 14

evidenceRows.effect: Ownership of 8M USDC Vault transferred to wallet 14 via reinitializeV2
Unlimited approval of Treasury USDC to wallet 14
Gas optimization: SLOAD reduction on deposits and withdrawals
evidenceRows.describedQuote: deposit(uint256) falls from 48,712 to 48,390 gas and withdraw(uint256) from 53,104 to 52,877 gas.
